directive.quote: Inspect actual current head, CI and source; fix root causes without weakening checks or inventing provenance.

preserve: judge the bundler actual import graph against each package declared public files
retain object declarations and kind filtering
report malformed or unreadable declarations and private cross-package imports
allowed_deltas: export the existing declaration projection for other maintained consumers
accept root arrays and path-string entries through explicit empty lenses
keep kind filtering optional only as an explicit paired schema choice
refuse inherited properties and invalid paths
banned_substitutions: read dirty declarations as committed authority
grant admission when the published reader API is unavailable
invent a default declaration or widen a package public boundary
